capabilities: highlight code block lines with the hl_lines option
highlight selected lines from the right-click menu
support single numbers, arrays, and ranges like 3-5
extras: Only works in Live Preview or Source mode, not Reader mode; only the hl_lines property is supported.
problem: Obsidian code blocks have no built-in way to mark specific lines as highlighted the way Hugo static sites do.

relations.evidence: highlights lines in code blocks using the same syntax as Hugo

summary: Plugin that highlights selected lines in code blocks using Hugo's hl_lines syntax, via an option or a right-click menu action.
